title: hoodia pilifera subsp. annulata
intro: Hoodia pilifera subsp. annulata, commonly known as Hoodia annulata or Annular-leaved Hoodia, is a succulent plant species native to southern Africa. It is prized for its potential health benefits, which include appetite suppression and weight management, as well as its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Hoodia annulata are attributed to its ability to stimulate the release of cholecystokinin, a hormone that reduces appetite and increases feelings of fullness. The bioactive constituents of Hoodia annulata include iridoid glycosides, particularly hoodia glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
